prereq: 一个空仓库、可记录的真实工作样本，以及一位愿意持续反馈的首位用户。
允许观察全人工流程与直接使用 Codex 的基线，不要求系统已经存在。
本阶段不接入真实发送、支付、删除或系统设置修改。
contracts: 界面只消费稳定的 TaskCard projection，不读取数据库字段或内部任务对象。
状态变化必须进入 append-only Event Log；同一事件流可以重建页面。
未识别的状态只能进入“需要处理”，不能默认显示为完成或成功。
mock server 与前端契约测试随 schema 一起提交，CI 拦截回归。
failures: 页面显示“需要处理”，并记录未识别的 projection 字段和任务 ID。
补齐状态映射、更新契约测试，再重新演示原路径。
任务保留在候选池，标注原因，不进入开发承诺。
补清输入、产物或验收方式，或换一个真实任务。
该任务不进入评测集，避免用失真的数据证明价值。
重新记录人工分钟、成功率、Token 与失败类型。
exclusions: 不先做完整内核再补界面。
不用文档完成度替代可点击原型与可重复评测。
不接入真实高风险外部副作用。

prereq: An empty repository, a recordable set of real work samples, and one first user willing to keep giving feedback.
Baselines for fully manual work and direct Codex use are observable before the system exists.
This stage does not connect real sending, payment, deletion, or system-setting changes.
contracts: The UI consumes only a stable TaskCard projection; it never reads database columns or internal task objects.
Every state change enters an append-only Event Log; the same event stream can rebuild the page.
An unrecognized state can only become Needs attention, never Completed or Successful.
A mock server and frontend contract tests ship with the schema, and CI blocks regressions.
failures: A prototype state cannot be mapped
The page shows Needs attention and records the unknown projection field and task ID.
Add the mapping, update contract tests, and replay the original path.
A real task cannot be accepted
The task stays in the candidate pool with a reason; it never becomes a build commitment.
Clarify inputs, artifacts, or acceptance, or replace the task.
The task stays out of the evaluation set so distorted data cannot prove value.
Recapture manual minutes, success rate, Token usage, and failure type.
exclusions: Do not build a complete kernel before the interface.
Do not substitute document completion for a clickable prototype and repeatable evaluation.
Do not connect real high-risk external side effects.

zh.title: 产品楔子与真实任务基线
zh.lead: 先把“谁在什么场景下为什么使用 Hearth”与可验收的真实任务集固定下来；后续原型、契约和评测都以它为准。
zh.outcome: 一份清晰的产品说明、至少 12 个可验收任务，以及全人工与直接使用 Codex 的两条基线。
steps: 选定首位真实用户、最高频场景和第一个任务楔子，写清不用 Hearth 时人们会怎么做。
从真实工作记录收集 20–30 个候选任务，删除演示型、无法验证或没有真实需求的任务。
筛出至少 12 个任务，为每个任务写明输入、产物、验收方式和至少一个失败样本。
让任务集覆盖成功、失败、等待审批、需要信息和人工接管，不隐藏异常路径。
分别测量全人工与直接使用 Codex 的人工分钟、成功率、Token、失败类型和用户不满点。
写非目标、风险、成功指标和继续/停止判断，作为后续阶段可比较的基线。
zh.gate: 至少 12 个任务有明确输入、产物和验收方式；能说明 Hearth 的独立价值；任务集包含成功、失败、等待审批和需要接管的情况。
evidence: 非目标、风险与成功指标

en.title: Product wedge and real-task baseline
en.lead: Fix who uses Hearth, in which scenario, and why, together with a verifiable set of real tasks; the prototype, contracts, and evaluation all depend on it.
en.outcome: A clear product statement, at least 12 verifiable tasks, and baselines for both fully manual work and direct Codex use.
steps: Choose the first real user, the highest-frequency scenario, and the first task wedge; write down how the work is done without Hearth.
Collect 20–30 candidate tasks from real work records; remove demo-only, unverifiable, or invented requests.
Select at least 12 tasks and specify inputs, artifacts, acceptance, and at least one failure sample for each.
Cover success, failure, waiting for approval, missing information, and human takeover instead of hiding exception paths.
Measure manual minutes, success rate, Token usage, failure type, and dissatisfaction for fully manual and direct Codex baselines.
Write non-goals, risks, success metrics, and continue/stop criteria as a comparable baseline for later stages.
en.gate: At least 12 tasks have explicit inputs, artifacts, and acceptance; Hearth's independent value is clear; the set includes success, failure, approval waits, and takeover.

zh.title: 可点击的端到端产品原型
zh.lead: 在写真实执行内核之前，先用可点击原型证明用户能完成一条完整任务路径，并且异常状态也有明确的下一步。
zh.outcome: 一个覆盖四个入口与七种任务状态、在桌面和手机宽度都能走通的端到端原型。
steps: 设计今日、需要你、产物、设置四个入口，让用户从当前任务和待处理事项开始。
覆盖排队、执行、等待审批、需要信息、完成、失败和可恢复七种状态。
为每种状态只保留一个主行动作，并把次要动作收进详情或更多菜单。
隐藏 Worker、Harness、Mandate 等内部术语，用用户能理解的原因和下一步替代。
用接近真实的模拟数据演示创建、审批、失败恢复和取回产物的完整路径。
检查桌面与手机布局，并让每个原型字段都能映射到真实 projection。
zh.gate: 新用户不看说明也能完成主要路径；每个状态只有一个主动作；没有内部术语；失败状态给出下一步；原型状态可映射到真实投影字段。
evidence: 可点击原型与走查脚本
状态-主动作-投影字段映射表

en.title: Clickable end-to-end product prototype
en.lead: Before building the real execution kernel, prove with a clickable prototype that a user can finish one complete task path and that failures have a clear next step.
en.outcome: An end-to-end prototype with four entry points and seven task states that works at both desktop and phone widths.
steps: Design Today, Needs You, Artifacts, and Settings entry points so work begins with the current task and what needs attention.
Cover queued, running, waiting for approval, needs information, completed, failed, and recoverable states.
Keep exactly one primary action per state and move secondary actions into details or a More menu.
Hide internal terms such as Worker, Harness, and Mandate; explain the reason and next step in user language.
Use realistic mock data to demonstrate creation, approval, failure recovery, and artifact retrieval end to end.
Check desktop and phone layouts, and map every prototype field to a real projection.
en.gate: A new user can finish the main path without instructions; each state has one primary action; no internal jargon appears; failures give a next step; states map to real projections.

zh.title: 协议、状态机与 UI 数据契约
zh.lead: 把原型中的状态、主动作、证据和产物变成稳定契约，让真实后端可以逐步替换 mock，而不重写用户路径。
zh.outcome: 核心实体、状态迁移、UI 投影、事件接口和契约测试共同组成一份可实施的协议。
steps: 定义 Event、Task、Ticket、Run、Executor、Approval、Artifact、Receipt、Budget 的字段和关系。
定义 Task Pack、Result、失败分类，以及每种失败面向用户的解释和可恢复动作。
定义任务卡、审批和产物三类 projection，确保界面不依赖内部数据库结构。
确定 Event Log、outbox、lease、schema migration 与 SSE 的接口边界。
建立 mock server，用同一事件流驱动原型，并为主路径和异常路径编写契约测试。
用 schema 版本化和未知状态降级规则保证演进不会让页面假装成功。
zh.gate: 前端不依赖内部数据库字段；核心状态迁移有唯一解释；schema 可版本化；事件流能重建投影；未知状态安全显示为“需要处理”。

en.title: Protocols, state machine, and UI data contracts
en.lead: Turn prototype states, primary actions, evidence, and artifacts into stable contracts so a real backend can replace mocks without rewriting user paths.
en.outcome: Core entities, state transitions, UI projections, event interfaces, and contract tests form an implementable protocol.
steps: Define the fields and relationships for Event, Task, Ticket, Run, Executor, Approval, Artifact, Receipt, and Budget.
Define Task Pack, Result, the failure taxonomy, and the user explanation and recovery action for each failure.
Define task-card, approval, and artifact projections so the UI never depends on internal database structure.
Set interface boundaries for the Event Log, outbox, lease, schema migration, and SSE.
Build a mock server that drives the prototype from one event stream, with contract tests for success and failure paths.
Version schemas and degrade unknown states safely so evolution never makes the page pretend to succeed.
en.gate: The frontend does not depend on database columns; every core transition has one explanation; schemas are versioned; projections rebuild from events; unknown states become Needs attention.

zh.title: 评测、安全与工程基线
zh.lead: 让后续每一个增量从第一天起都能被重复验证、被安全约束，并在 CI 中阻止契约与数据回归。
zh.outcome: 可重复的 12 任务评测、明确的安全边界，以及可运行的类型检查、测试、CI 和 fake executor。
steps: 为 12 个任务建立评测 runner、评分规则、失败分类和人工复核记录。
完成威胁模型、风险分级、审批矩阵、秘密处理规则与高风险动作禁用清单。
初始化 monorepo、lint、类型检查、单元/契约测试、ADR 模板和文档目录。
实现 fake executor，使完整 UI 流程可以无真实副作用地运行和回放。
定义 Token、成本、延迟、人工分钟、打断次数与失败类型的采集字段。
把评测、schema 校验、迁移检查和危险动作拦截接入 CI，作为合并门槛。
zh.gate: 评测可在本地重复运行；高风险动作必须有审批路径；CI 能阻止 schema 和契约回归；fake executor 能驱动完整 UI；没有真实外部副作用。

en.title: Evaluation, security, and engineering baseline
en.lead: Make every later increment repeatably verifiable and safely bounded from day one, with CI preventing contract and data regressions.
en.outcome: A repeatable 12-task evaluation, explicit safety boundaries, and working type checks, tests, CI, and a fake executor.
steps: Build an evaluation runner, scoring rules, failure taxonomy, and manual review records for the 12 tasks.
Complete the threat model, risk levels, approval matrix, secret-handling rules, and a deny list for high-risk actions.
Initialize the monorepo, linting, type checking, unit and contract tests, ADR template, and documentation structure.
Implement a fake executor so the full UI can run and replay without real side effects.
Define capture fields for Token, cost, latency, manual minutes, interruptions, and failure classes.
Connect evaluation, schema validation, migration checks, and dangerous-action blocking to CI as merge gates.
en.gate: Evaluation repeats locally; high-risk actions have an approval path; CI blocks schema and contract regressions; the fake executor drives the full UI; no real external side effect exists.
